jobs.title: Enterprise Solutions Architect (gn)
jobs.description:
Einleitung

Enterprise Solution Architect (gn)
Schwerpunkt EAM-Plattform und Governance

Wie oft im Leben bekommt man die Chance, Enterprise Architecture nicht zu reparieren, sondern von null aufzubauen? 

Die meisten EAM-Rollen beginnen mit einem Erbe: ein Tool, das vor Jahren jemand anderes gekauft hat, ein Repository mit Stand von vorgestern, eine Community, die sich aus Pflicht trifft. Diese Rolle beginnt mit einem leeren Blatt.

Unser Mandant, ein international tätiger Dienstleistungskonzern mit mehreren tausend Mitarbeitenden, stellt seine IT gerade organisatorisch neu auf. Die Holding, die alle Geschäftsbereiche steuert, baut dabei Enterprise Architecture Management als eigenständige Funktion auf, mit eigenem Tooling, eigenen Prozessen und konzernweiter Geltung. Tool-Auswahl, Metamodell, Governance: nichts davon ist entschieden. Das wird deine Entscheidung. Solche Konstellationen gibt es selten und sie halten nicht lange. In zwei Jahren ist die neue IT-Organisation gesetzt, und wer dann kommt, arbeitet in Strukturen, die jemand anderes gebaut hat. Jetzt ist der Moment, in dem man sie baut.

Worum es geht 
Enterprise Architecture scheitert selten an fehlenden Frameworks. Sie scheitert daran, dass niemand das Repository pflegt, das Tool nicht mit den Quellsystemen spricht und die Architektur-Community nach dem dritten Meeting einschläft. Diese Rolle verhindert genau das. Du baust die Grundlage, auf der EAM in diesem Konzern funktioniert. Prozesse, die Menschen tatsächlich befolgen. Eine Plattform, die ihre Daten automatisiert bezieht, statt dass jemand sie abtippt.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du definierst, wie Architekturarbeit im Konzern abläuft: Prozessmodelle, Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten, Beschreibungen und Anforderungskataloge.
  • Du wählst das EAM-Tool aus, von der Marktsondierung über die Ausschreibung bis zur Entscheidung, und verantwortest danach Implementierung und Konfiguration.
  • Du konzipierst die Anbindung an Konfigurationsdatenbank, Service-Management und Cloud-Umgebungen, damit das Repository aktuell bleibt, ohne dass jemand es manuell nachführt.
  • Du entwickelst das Architektur-Metamodell weiter, wenn Geschäft oder Technologie es verlangen und misst die Reife der Prozesse regelmäßig gegen Industriestandards.
  • Du probierst neue Methoden aus, etwa Capability Maps oder Wertstromanalysen, und entscheidest, was davon in diesen Konzern passt.
  • Du sorgst für Betrieb und Skalierbarkeit der Plattform, inklusive Rollen und Zugriffskonzepten und definierst Kennzahlen für Datenqualität.
  • Du entwirfst Schulungs- und Onboarding-Formate, pflegst die Dokumentation und schreibst die Leitfäden, die neue Nutzende wirklich lesen.


Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Solution- oder Enterprise-Architektur, gern mit technischer Leitungsverantwortung für eine gewachsene IT-Landschaft.
  • Praxis in Einführung und Administration eines marktgängigen EAM-Tools, etwa Ardoq, LeanIX, Sparx EA oder vergleichbar.
  • Sichere Anwendung gängiger Architektur-Frameworks wie TOGAF oder ArchiMate, idealerweise zertifiziert.
  • Erfahrung mit Architektur-Boards oder Communities, und ein Gespür dafür, wie man sie am Leben hält.
  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse.


Benefits

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit in einer Konzernholding mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Ein sicherer Arbeitgeber! 
  • Eine Rolle, die es in dieser Form vorher nicht gab, mit entsprechendem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Individuelle Weiterbildung, von Fachtrainings bis Coaching.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Option, mobil zu arbeiten (hybrid).
  • Externe, kostenfreie vertrauliche Beratung zu beruflichen und privaten Themen.
  • Ein breites internes Netzwerk über alle Geschäftsbereiche hinweg.

jobs.title: Lead Product Engineer (a)
jobs.description:
Über uns

MEONDI ist Unternehmenspartner für Digitalisierung und neue Arbeitsstrukturen. Wir navigieren unsere Kunden ganzheitlich durch Innovations- und Transformationsprozesse sowie agile Produktentwicklungen.
Mit MEONDI Frontier Services beschäftigen wir uns gezielt mit neuen Technologien und den Möglichkeiten, die daraus für Unternehmen entstehen. Wir beraten unsere Kunden dabei nicht nur, sondern entwickeln gemeinsam mit ihnen neue Konzepte, validieren diese früh und setzen daraus konkrete digitale Produkte und Lösungen um.
Unser Anspruch ist es, neue technologische Möglichkeiten früh zu verstehen, sinnvoll auf reale Probleme zu übertragen und daraus Lösungen zu entwickeln, die tatsächlich im Alltag funktionieren.
Du willst nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern Verantwortung dafür übernehmen, dass aus einer Produktidee ein belastbares Softwareprodukt wird?
Als Lead Product Engineer bist du ein zentraler Teil von MEONDI Frontier Services und gestaltest mit uns, wie wir neue Produkte technisch denken und umsetzen. Du bringst die technische Perspektive von Anfang an in wichtige Entscheidungen ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Konsequenzen dieser Entscheidungen.
Dabei arbeitest du nicht in einer fertig definierten Rolle mit klar abgegrenzten Aufgaben. Du gestaltest die technische Seite unseres Produktgeschäfts aktiv mit, setzt Standards, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und baust selbst mit. Wenn wir mit unseren Produkten erfolgreich skalieren, wächst auch dein Verantwortungsbereich mit.
Du verbindest fundiertes Software Engineering mit einem praktischen Verständnis für AI-Produkte und agentische Systeme. Du weißt, wo AI sinnvoll eingesetzt werden kann, wo klassische Softwarelogik notwendig bleibt und wie beides zu stabilen, skalierbaren und wirtschaftlich tragfähigen Produkten zusammenkommt.

Zusätzliche Reisebereitschaft ist erforderlich und richtet sich nach dem jeweiligen Kundenprojekt. Je nach Projekt arbeitest du regelmäßig und möglicherweise mehrere Tage pro Woche vor Ort beim Kunden. Remote-Arbeit ist grundsätzlich möglich, sofern die jeweiligen Projekt- und Kundenanforderungen dies zulassen. Darüber hinaus solltest du bereit sein, regelmäßig bei MEONDI, insbesondere im Raum Stuttgart, präsent zu sein und an internen MEONDI-Events sowie Community-Treffen teilzunehmen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt:

Lead Product Engineer (a)


Deine Aufgaben

  • Technische Machbarkeit bewerten: Opportunities früh hinsichtlich Architektur, Risiken, Aufwand und Umsetzbarkeit einschätzen.
  • Technische Verantwortung übernehmen: Produktspezifikationen in tragfähige technische Lösungen übersetzen und zentrale Architekturentscheidungen treffen.
  • Hands-on Software entwickeln: Produktive Software selbst bauen – vom Frontend über Backend und Datenhaltung bis zu Schnittstellen und Betrieb.
  • Produktionsreife sicherstellen: Stabilität, Skalierbarkeit, Security, DevOps, Observability, Wartbarkeit und Betrieb von Anfang an berücksichtigen.
  • Prototypen in Produkte überführen: Schnelle Validierungen technisch einordnen und daraus belastbare, langfristig tragfähige Systeme entwickeln.
  • AI-native Softwaresysteme entwickeln: Verstehen, wo AI sinnvoll eingesetzt wird, wo klassische Softwarelogik notwendig bleibt und wie beides zu stabilen Produkten zusammenkommt.
  • AI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung weiterentwickeln: Moderne Coding Agents und neue Engineering-Ansätze praktisch einsetzen, kritisch bewerten und sinnvoll in die Entwicklungsarbeit integrieren.
  • Engineering-Standards prägen: Architekturprinzipien, Tooling, Entwicklungsprozesse und Qualitätsstandards für Frontier Services mit aufbauen.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast einen belastbaren Track Record mit produktiv eingesetzter Software.
  • Du hast bereits Verantwortung für Software übernommen und kennst die Anforderungen, die daraus im echten Betrieb entstehen.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in einem Produktumfeld oder einer vergleichbaren Situation mit echtem Skin in the Game für Qualität, Nutzen und Betrieb der Software.
  • Du kannst offene und unvollständig definierte Probleme selbstständig strukturieren, Lösungswege entwickeln und die richtigen nächsten Schritte bestimmen.
  • Du kannst dich nicht hinter großen Teams oder eng geschnittenen Tickets verstecken, sondern übernimmst Ownership für das Ergebnis.
  • Du besitzt ein starkes Full-Stack-Verständnis und kannst vollständige Anwendungen eigenständig entwickeln.
  • Du beherrschst die Grundlagen moderner Softwareentwicklung sicher – von Datenbanken, APIs und Architektur bis zu Testing, Cloud, Deployment, Security und Betrieb.
  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs, AI-Agenten und AI-basierten Anwendungen und verstehst, wie diese mit klassischer Softwarelogik zusammenspielen.
  • Du nutzt Coding Agents und AI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge produktiv und kannst deren Möglichkeiten und Grenzen realistisch einschätzen.
  • Du verbindest hohe Qualitätsansprüche mit Pragmatismus. Du vermeidest sowohl Overengineering als auch kurzfristige Lösungen, deren Konsequenzen später andere tragen müssen.
  • Du arbeitest gerne hands-on und validierst technische Entscheidungen im Code und in realen Systemen.
  • Englisch: sehr gute, verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse.
  • Deutsch: ein klarer Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.
Kein bestimmter Abschluss erforderlich. Entscheidend sind technisches Urteilsvermögen, praktische Erfahrung und die Fähigkeit, produktive Software ganzheitlich zu entwickeln. Ein technisches Studium kann hilfreich sein, ist aber keine Voraussetzung.


Das kannst du von uns erwarten

Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung
Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau unseres zukünftigen Produktgeschäfts. Du erhältst großen Einfluss auf Architektur, Toolchain, Engineering-Prinzipien und technische Ausrichtung.

Kultur und Zusammenarbeit
Bei MEONDI erwartet dich eine Kultur, die von Offenheit, Transparenz und Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe geprägt ist. Wir glauben an unternehmerisches Denken, Eigenverantwortung und daran, dass nachhaltige Lösungen im echten Dialog entstehen.

Eigenverantwortung und Vertrauen
Du erhältst den Freiraum, deine Aufgaben selbstständig zu gestalten. Wir setzen auf Vertrauen statt Mikromanagement und auf Ergebnisorientierung statt Präsenzkultur.

Flexibilität und Arbeitsmodell
Mobile Working ist bei uns gelebte Realität. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub ermöglichen dir, Beruf und Leben in Einklang zu bringen – remote, in einem unserer Hubs oder beim Kunden.

Professionelle Rahmenbedingungen und Benefits
Wir statten dich mit hochwertiger technischer Ausstattung aus, darunter MacBook und ein auch privat nutzbares iPhone.

Weiterentwicklung und Perspektive
Du gestaltest eine Rolle mit, die mit unserem Produktgeschäft wachsen soll. Bei erfolgreichem Product-Market-Fit besteht die Perspektive, die technische Leitung des Bereichs zu übernehmen und ein Engineering-Team aufzubauen.

Gemeinschaft und Austausch
Unsere Hubs sind bewusst als Orte für Workshops, Reviews und Zusammenarbeit konzipiert. Wir schaffen Räume für echten Austausch, gemeinsames Lernen und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung.


Kontakt

jobs.title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Agora Industry

Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries.  Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a
 
Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin 
 
You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams.


Your responsibilities include

  • Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR).
  • Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. 
  • Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms
  • Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks.  
  • Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. 
  • Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors.
  • Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. 
  • Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions.
  • Actively contributing to internal discussions.
  • Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables.
  • As Project Officer, the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. 
  • As Project Manager, the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication.


We are looking for

  • A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar 
  • As Project Officer: Preferably 2 years of experience (including internships, student work or post-graduate roles) in the field of quantitative analysis of biomass systems.
  • As Project Manager: At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years specifically in the field of biomass
  • A proven track record and expertise in biomass supply cost, transport logistics and conversion technologies. 
  • Solid knowledge of the farming and forestry sectors.
  • Familiarity with agricultural systems and ideally forest systems in different world regions is a plus. 
  • Good background understanding of industrial transformation is a plus.
  • Experience with Life-Cycle Assessment is a plus. 
  • Familiarity with sustainable biomass certification and deforestation-free frameworks is a plus.
  • Strong networking skills and the ability to engage with business, industry associations, research partners and policy makers.
  • A creative and result-oriented mind, capable of developing new ideas and proposals with a view to having impact.
  • Outstanding communication skills, both verbal and written; track-record in writing high quality documents.
  • Full command of the English language in reading and writing, knowledge of other languages is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel outside Europe. 

 We assume that there are excellent candidates for the job who do not meet all the criteria in the description. Maybe you have certain skills we haven’t thought of yet? Tell us why you are the right person for the job.


What we offer

  • An opportunity to work in a mission-driven, highly motivated, and professional international team.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and advancement; including access to a mental well-being platform.
  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid work environment, with access to an attractive office space in central Berlin and a good setup to work from home.
  • Weekly breakfast, team events and other get-togethers with colleagues from around the globe.
  • One option from our benefit basket (e.g. job ticket, shopping vouchers, Urban Sports, etc.).
  • Opportunities for professional and personal development and advancement.

  • Assistance with visa and work permits for international candidates if required.
  • A structured onboarding programme and regular team and organisation-wide retreats to bring us all together; and

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Paris
jobs.description:
About H:

When we released Holo4 on 28 September, we published every trajectory behind its public benchmark scores at trajectories.hcompany.ai. For OSWorld that's 369 desktop tasks, each run 3 times, with the steps, tokens and time of every attempt. This role builds and runs the evaluation framework that produces runs like these.

H builds computer-use agents and the models behind them. Developers use them through a managed API, and our forward deployed engineers take them into enterprise workflows.

 

What this team owns

The evaluation framework: orchestration, runtimes and observability. Researchers and forward deployed engineers bring the benchmarks, across web apps, desktop applications and the command line. Your job is to make the framework that runs them reliable, fast and cheap, and to make adding a new one quick. Research uses the results to choose checkpoints and decide whether a model ships. Product and the forward deployed engineers use them to measure agents on customer workflows. It carries roughly 50 benchmarks now. That number should be between 100 and 200 soon, and the framework has to keep up.

 

What you'd be doing

  • Time with customers, from single developers to large companies, to find out what they want measured, then automating it so the results flow back into our harnesses and models.

 

The first few months

By 3 months you'll have helped researchers or forward deployed engineers integrate 5 benchmarks, and started fixing what slows the framework down. By 6 months one part of it is yours, for example scaling the runs, observability, or a group of related benchmarks, and a release will have gone out on your numbers. By 12 months you'll know the design and trade-offs of the whole evaluation system, and be the person the rest of H asks about evaluations.

Ceiran Chapman, our VP Engineering, is hiring for this role. You'd join the evaluation team. The people relying on your work day to day are H's researchers and forward deployed engineers.

 

What we think it takes

  • Have spent 5+ years in backend development, with production Python at the core, and use coding agents to go faster without letting quality drop.

  • Have built test, QA or evaluation tooling that other teams depended on, and care whether a number is right.

  • Have operated distributed systems on Kubernetes in a public cloud. AWS experience helps most.

  • Have built and shipped systems end to end, including APIs (REST or GraphQL) and integrations with outside services.

  • Know relational and non-relational databases, and message queues such as SQS, RabbitMQ or Kafka.

  • Instrument what you build, with metrics, tracing and monitoring from the start.

Stronger still if you have

  • Measured LLM quality before, or built agents yourself.

  • Packaged and run workloads in Docker and on virtual machines.

  • Automated web or desktop software with Playwright, Selenium or a browser extension you wrote.

You do not need a background in machine learning. We'll work that out with you. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway.

 

How we hire

A 30 minute call with our Talent team, a 60 minute technical challenge, a 60 minute system design interview, and a 30 minute final conversation with Ceiran. About 3.5 hours in total.

About us, and our mission

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with a large cohort of patient-derived tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical outcomes, validate therapies and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we aim to make drug development smarter, faster and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies. Backed by leading investors, Orakl is a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of biology, automation and AI.

Position overview

Orakl runs a high-throughput 3D cell‑culture platform to culture patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These patient-derived specimens reveal critical information into the patient disease, but require heavy maintenance work. Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. This is a high ownership and high autonomy job. You will map our processes, decide what to automate and what to leave alone, specify and source the equipment, negotiate with vendors and integrators, commission the machines, run them with the lab team, and hire the people the function needs. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. While previous experience in biology is a plus, it is not a strict requirement: you will be taught all you need to know. However, you do need a proven experience in working deeply embedded in interdisciplinary teams.

Key responsibilities

  • Map cell culture workflows end to end and identify key process automation and optimisation opportunities.

  • Own the automation roadmap. Present and lead the implementation of the major decisions to Orakl’s leadership.

  • In line with the automation strategy you will have identified, evaluate vendors and integrators. Write user requirement specifications, acceptance criteria and interface requirements for each project.

  • Negotiate price, scope, delivery, acceptance, support and consumables terms autonomously within agreed thresholds.

  • Lead design reviews and factory and site acceptance tests.

  • Translate our proprietary cell culture protocols into automated machine execution with our team of cell biologists and scientists.

  • Track machine availability, hands-on time per line, interventions, failures and recovery time. Use the data to decide the next step.

  • Coordinate with Orakl’s management to anticipate future automation needs on the platform and adjust the roadmap accordingly.

  • Hire and develop the automation technicians and engineers the roadmap needs.

  • Set the standards for the automated platform: documentation, quality control, safety, qualification, change control, vendor management.

In this role you will collaborate closely with our cell culture, cell biology and data science teams. You will be at the heart of Orakl Oncology’s capabilities roadmap and help generate unprecedented amounts of biological data to power scientific discovery in cancer.

Key qualifications

Must-have

  • Engineering degree (generalist, robotics, industrial, mechanical or process engineering) or equivalent, and at least eight years of experience.

  • Exceptional process thinking skills: you map flows, time operations, find bottlenecks and question the processes.

  • Experience in supplier negotiation and budget ownership on your own projects.

  • Experience in PLC and robot programming concepts, scheduling software, instrument interfaces, basic scripting.

  • You enjoy and are comfortable spending time on the floor with operators. You have experience in communicating and operating with engineers, technicians and workers at the heart of production processes.

  • Autonomy: you tell your manager what you decided and why, not what you need decided.

  • Fluency in English is required.

Nice-to-have

  • You have put automated lines, cells or special machines into service end to end: requirements, vendor selection, negotiation, integration, factory and site acceptance, ramp-up, budget. This doesn’t have to be in a lab environment : plant, food and fermentation, pharma or cosmetics are other examples of relevant experience.

  • Automation in life-science or regulated environments: cell culture, biotech, food and fermentation, pharma, cleanroom or BSL-2 work.

  • A working understanding of cell culture and what it demands: sterility, contamination risk, variability between samples, and steps governed by the biological pace.

  • Liquid handling, plate-based workflows, incubators and imagers; laboratory scheduling software.

  • Experience hiring and leading an automation team.

What we offer

  • You will be Orakl's first automation hire. You will have a unique degree of ownership and scope with a strong mandate to deliver.

  • Short decision lines and fast execution.

  • An interdisciplinary environment with a results-driven culture.

Recruitment process

  1. Introductory call with Talent / People — 20 minutes

  2. Interview with the Lab Director, hiring manager — 45 minutes, including a 15-minute live mini-case on a small lab process

  3. Technical deep dive with the CTO and the Lab Director

  4. Case study on a real part of our lab: a take-home capped at four hours, then a half day on site with presentation, challenge round, lab walk.

  5. Cross-functional interviews with the technicians who run the culture, Platform Operations, the Senior Laboratory Engineers and the Data team — 60 minutes

  6. Reference calls: a former manager, a vendor or integrator you negotiated with, and an operator who ran a line you delivered

  7. Founder conversation — 45 minutes

We’re looking for experienced, deeply curious technical problem-solvers to serve as trusted support partners for our Premium Support customers. Beyond resolving individual issues, you’ll use your deep understanding of OpenAI’s infrastructure and products, together with each customer’s architecture and operating context, to anticipate risk and make their workloads more resilient over time. You’ll proactively monitor integrations, identify emerging failure patterns and architectural breakpoints, and work with customers and internal teams to address them before they become incidents. In this role, you will:

  • Work directly with Premium Support customers to troubleshoot their most complex technical issues, including API failures, integration challenges, authentication errors, unexpected product behavior, performance degradation, and production incidents.

Where possible, you’ll identify the root cause before escalating to Engineering; where that is not possible, you’ll provide a clear hypothesis and the evidence needed to accelerate Engineering’s investigation.

  • Translate recurring customer pain into clear, evidence-backed feedback for Product and Engineering, with a particular focus on improving the reliability and performance of existing products, integrations, and deployments.

By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

 

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

 

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do

  • Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement:

  • Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

  • Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

  • Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

  • Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

  • Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

 

Project Management:

  • Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

  • Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

  • Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

 

Mentorship & Coaching:

  • Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

  • Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

 

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

  • Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

  • Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

  • Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

  • Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

  • Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

  • Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

 

Driving Organisational Change:

  • Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

  • Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.

Skills: what you'll have

  • Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

  • Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

  • Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

  • Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

  • Fluent English & French is a prerequisite

 

Experience

  • Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

  • Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

  • Change management using agile methodologies.

  • Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. 

 

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs.

  • Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages.

  • Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports.

  • Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions.

  • Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration.

  • Fluent French & English is a prerequisite for this role

jobs.description:
About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

his is a pure new-logo role. You will win the large, multi-country property owners, operators and facilities management organisations that do not yet work with Singu, running the full cycle from first cold conversation to signature. Once an account is live, Customer Success takes it forward.

Why Singu

Singu is building a leading international property operations platform. We support more than 250 million square metres of property, retain over 98% of our customers, profitable and growing at double digits year on year with backing from K1 Investment Management.

Our customers already include seven of Europe’s ten largest logistics platforms, the five leading global commercial real estate advisers and 17 of Europe’s top 20 facilities management providers.

What To Expect

  • A defined greenfield territory of named target accounts

  • Reference customers with genuine weight in the market and proof points that survive scrutiny.

  • Direct access to the CRO and CEO, who will show up on your deals when it matters, with Presales, Business Development, Marketing and Product behind you.

  • Uncapped commission with accelerators - overperformance is rewarded.

  • A credible path into enterprise sales leadership as the new-business function scales.

What You Will Own

Pipeline Creation

  • Build and work a named target-account list across your territory, with a written point of view on why each account should change and what it would take.

  • Generate the majority of your own pipeline, at coverage that supports next year’s number rather than this quarter’s. Business development and marketing will contribute; they will not carry you.

  • Multi-thread into C-suite and operational leadership through outbound, industry networks, events, partners and existing customer relationships.

Winning Complex Enterprise Deals

  • Run the full cycle: first conversation, discovery, business case, evaluation, negotiation and signature.

  • Displace incumbent CAFM and IWMS platforms, in-house systems and entrenched spreadsheet processes.

  • Navigate multi-country buying groups, procurement, IT security and legal without losing momentum.

  • Qualify hard using MEDDICC and with mutual action plans on every live deal.

  • Shape commercial structure: pricing, multi-year terms, phased rollouts and land-and-expand entry points that create a platform for growth.

  • Sell what we can deliver and hand over cleanly.

Executive Credibility

  • Earn access to CFOs, COOs, CIOs, Heads of Real Estate and workplace and transformation sponsors, and hold the room once you are in it.

  • Lead with the commercial case: operating cost, compliance exposure, portfolio performance and risk, rather than a feature demonstration.

  • Mobilise Presales, Product and executive sponsorship around the opportunities that justify it.

Forecast and Commercial Discipline

  • Maintain a forecast you can defend line by line, and a CRM that reflects reality rather than optimism.

  • Disqualify early and visibly. Time returned to a real deal is worth more than a full-looking pipeline.

  • Feed competitive and market intelligence back into product, marketing and pricing.

What Excellent Performance Looks Like

  • New-logo ARR closed against target, and the calibre of the logos, how many become referenceable

  • Self-sourced pipeline as a share of total pipeline

  • Win rate and average deal size within the named target segment

  • Forecast accuracy against commit

  • Deal quality: economic buyer access, mutual action plan, MEDDICC completeness

  • Speed and honesty of disqualification, and clean handover into onboarding

What We’re Looking For

  • A sustained record of exceeding new-business quota

  • Complex enterprise deals closed at six or seven-figure value across borders, involving multiple stakeholders, procurement and IT security review.

  • Demonstrable self-sourced pipeline: the accounts you opened cold, how you got in, and what you actually said.

  • Commercial credibility at C-level, with the ability to build and defend a business case in front of a finance audience.

  • Comfort operating where the playbook is still being written, and the discipline to write down what works.

  • MEDDICC, or an equivalent qualification and messaging framework used in practice

  • CAFM, IWMS, facilities management, PropTech or real estate technology experience is an advantage, not a requirement.

Support, Package and Progression

  • Dedicated Solution Consulting, business development support, and marketing programmes aimed at your segment.

  • An established customer base and proof points that open doors, plus CEO and CRO sponsorship on request.

  • Competitive salary with uncapped commission and accelerators above target.

  • Genuine progression into enterprise sales leadership as the new-business team grows.

If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

Role Purpose

CRM at Neko is a newer but critical function, and this role exists to define its strategy and turn it into one of the company's core growth engines. You will be accountable for the CRM outcomes that matter most as we bring proactive, preventive healthcare to billions of people: converting leads and the waitlist into booked scans and bringing members back for their next scan and their next referral.

This isn't stewarding an established machine. You will set the vision, the operating model, and the investment case, scale the implementation of our CRM platform and practices across markets, and build the organization that delivers it – to the same standard of excellence and care our clinics deliver in person.

You will lead through others, building and directing a multi-market team, and work with Marketing, Comms, and Product, alongside other business functions. You will influence executive decisions on growth and be accountable for CRM's financial contribution to the business.

In the early months, you will be close to the work: operating the platform, shaping test briefs and making content calls alongside the team, while you hire the people to take on more of the day-to-day work.

CRM at Neko is at an early stage. Today the function is a small team running email and SMS, with the potential to implement and optimize the right messaging at every stage. We are currently implementing Braze over Q4 2026.

  • Build the organization: hire the first layer of the CRM function, creating a high-performing team, including leads and managers, define the structure by region, channel or lifecycle stage, and grow future leaders.

À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom

Missions

  • Analyser les enjeux de sécurité, de vie privée et d’éthique liés au déploiement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle (IA) dans des domaines critiques et variés, notamment la santé, la finance et les transports.

  • Étudier les méthodes d’apprentissage automatique préservant la vie privée (Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning – PPML) et leur capacité à répondre aux exigences réglementaires et éthiques, notamment celles découlant du RGPD et de l’AI Act.

  • Concevoir et évaluer des approches de protection de la vie privée dans des environnements d’apprentissage décentralisé, en particulier dans le cadre de l’apprentissage fédéré.

  • Identifier et caractériser les vulnérabilités de sécurité propres à l’apprentissage collaboratif et fédéré, notamment les attaques par empoisonnement de données, l’injection de portes dérobées (backdoors) et les attaques visant la confidentialité des données et des utilisateurs.

  • Étudier les mécanismes d’inférence à partir des mises à jour de modèles, notamment les attaques par inférence d’appartenance et par inférence de propriétés, afin d’évaluer les risques de divulgation d’informations sensibles.

  • Évaluer la robustesse et la confidentialité des modèles d’IA dans des contextes où les données, les nœuds et les processus d’apprentissage sont distribués et difficilement auditables.

  • Étudier les méthodes d’intelligence artificielle explicable (XAI) afin d’améliorer la transparence, l’interprétabilité et la compréhension des décisions produites par les modèles d’IA.

  • Analyser les interactions et compromis entre explicabilité, vie privée et robustesse dans les systèmes d’apprentissage décentralisé.

  • Développer et expérimenter des méthodes permettant de concilier transparence et protection de la vie privée, en tenant compte des contraintes propres aux environnements distribués.

  • Mettre en place des protocoles expérimentaux et des critères d’évaluation permettant de mesurer les niveaux de confidentialité, de robustesse et d’explicabilité des approches étudiées.

  • Contribuer à la valorisation et à la diffusion des résultats de recherche, notamment par la rédaction de publications scientifiques, la présentation des travaux dans des conférences et la participation aux échanges avec les partenaires du projet.

  • Assurer une veille scientifique et technologique sur les avancées en IA de confiance,

Activités

  • Concevoir et développer des mécanismes d’apprentissage décentralisé offrant de fortes garanties de confidentialité, une résistance aux comportements malveillants et des capacités d’explicabilité pertinentes.

  • Étudier la confidentialité des mécanismes d’explicabilité, en particulier les risques de fuite d’informations susceptibles d’être induits par les méthodes d’explicabilité appliquées aux modèles d’apprentissage fédéré.

  • Développer de nouvelles stratégies d’attaque et d’évaluation permettant de caractériser les informations susceptibles d’être divulguées par les mécanismes d’explicabilité.

  • Concevoir des mécanismes de protection adaptés permettant de limiter les fuites d’informations identifiées tout en préservant la qualité et la pertinence des explications produites.

  • Développer des approches d’apprentissage collaboratif conciliant confidentialité et explicabilité, en tenant compte des contraintes propres aux environnements fédérés et décentralisés.

  • Étudier l’utilisation de la confidentialité différentielle (Differential Privacy – DP) pour protéger les modèles agrégés contre les attaques par inférence et analyser son impact sur la qualité et la fidélité des explications.

  • Explorer des primitives cryptographiques adaptées à l’apprentissage fédéré, notamment le chiffrement partiellement ou totalement homomorphe et les techniques de calcul multipartite sécurisé (Secure Multi-Party Computation – MPC).

  • Combiner les mécanismes cryptographiques et la confidentialité différentielle afin d’explorer des compromis entre niveau de confidentialité, qualité des explications, coût de calcul et éventuelles fuites d’information.

  • Étudier l’impact des mécanismes de protection de la vie privée sur les méthodes d’explicabilité, notamment les méthodes fondées sur l’attribution, et identifier des stratégies permettant de préserver leur fidélité.

  • Analyser les vulnérabilités des systèmes d’apprentissage fédéré face aux attaques byzantines et aux attaques par empoisonnement, en particulier lorsque les stratégies adverses exploitent des métriques ou informations issues de l’explicabilité.

  • Étudier des scénarios d’attaque réalistes prenant en compte l’hétérogénéité et le déséquilibre des données détenues par les différents clients, l’empoisonnement des étiquettes (label poisoning) et la présence de clients associés à des attributs protégés.

  • Développer des algorithmes d’agrégation robustes et préservant la vie privée, capables de maintenir les performances du modèle dans des environnements comportant une proportion importante de participants malveillants.

  • Concevoir des mécanismes de défense adaptatifs exploitant l’explicabilité, notamment pour identifier les comportements anormaux, les mises à jour suspectes ou les participants potentiellement malveillants.

  • Analyser conjointement les compromis entre vie privée, robustesse, explicabilité et utilité du modèle, en intégrant également les contraintes liées à l’efficacité computationnelle et aux communications.

  • Définir des protocoles et métriques d’évaluation permettant de comparer les approches proposées selon différents niveaux de confidentialité, de robustesse, de fidélité des explications et de coût computationnel.

  • Expérimenter et évaluer les méthodes développées sur des scénarios réalistes d’apprentissage décentralisé, notamment dans le domaine de la santé et dans d’autres contextes traitant des données sensibles.

  • Contribuer à la validation expérimentale et à la valorisation des résultats, notamment par la mise en œuvre de prototypes, l’analyse des résultats, la rédaction de publications scientifiques et la présentation des travaux dans des événements scientifiques.

jobs.title: Ingénieur Assurance Qualité Projets
jobs.description:
Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace, Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Nous favorisons un environnement collaboratif dans lequel chacun peut développer son expertise et contribuer à des projets à forte valeur ajoutée dans le secteur des Life Sciences.

Dans le cadre de projets stratégiques au sein d'un environnement pharmaceutique, nous recherchons un Ingénieur Assurance Qualité Projets – Qualification & Validation pour accompagner des projets de transfert entrant de produits en formes sèches et conditionnement.

Intégré au pôle Assurance Qualité Qualification, Validation & Projets, vous serez le représentant de l'Assurance Qualité au sein des équipes projets. Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble des activités Qualité associées aux projets, depuis la définition de la stratégie de qualification jusqu'à l'exécution des qualifications et au suivi du système qualité.

Vos missions :

  • Représenter l'Assurance Qualité au sein des équipes projets et garantir l'application des politiques de qualification pour les nouveaux équipements.
  • Définir et rédiger la documentation Qualité associée aux projets, notamment les besoins utilisateurs, cahiers des charges, plans directeurs de validation et rapports associés.
  • Piloter le système qualité à l'échelle des projets : Change Controls, CAPA, déviations et gestion documentaire.
  • Réaliser les analyses de criticité et analyses de risques relatives aux équipements et systèmes mis en place.
  • Rédiger et revoir la documentation de qualification : FAT, SAT, QI, QO, QE et QP, selon les besoins des projets.
  • Participer à l'exécution des qualifications sur le terrain, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Utilisateurs et Ingénierie.
  • Revoir et contribuer à la rédaction des procédures, modes opératoires et autres documents Qualité nécessaires à la mise en exploitation.
  • Participer aux réunions de suivi des projets et assurer la représentation de l'Assurance Qualité auprès des différentes parties prenantes.
  • Veiller au respect des plannings de qualification et assurer le suivi des activités Qualité associées aux projets.
  • Contribuer aux démarches réglementaires nécessaires dans le cadre des modifications apportées aux installations.

Requirements

Chez Excelya, nous recherchons avant tout des professionnels rigoureux, autonomes et capables de collaborer efficacement avec des équipes multidisciplinaires.

  • Expérience : Vous disposez d'une expérience significative en Assurance Qualité et Qualification/Validation dans l'industrie pharmaceutique.
  • Expertise procédés : Vous possédez idéalement une expérience dans les procédés de formes sèches, notamment en extrusion, granulation sur LAF, compression et/ou conditionnement.
  • Qualification/Validation : Vous maîtrisez les activités de qualification d'équipements ainsi que la rédaction et l'exécution des protocoles et rapports associés.
  • Qualité : Vous êtes à l'aise avec la gestion des Change Controls, CAPA, déviations, analyses de risques et documentation GMP.
  • Réglementaire : Vous avez une bonne connaissance des GMP européennes et FDA, de l'Annexe 15 des EU GMP, du 21 CFR Part 11, des principes GAMP 5, ICH Q9 et ALCOA+.
  • Formation : Formation Ingénieur, Pharmacien ou niveau scientifique/technique équivalent.
  • Qualités personnelles : Rigueur, autonomie, organisation, capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse, aisance relationnelle et capacité à travailler en équipe projet.
  • Langues : Anglais professionnel niveau B2 minimum, permettant de rédiger de la documentation GMP en anglais et de participer à des réunions ou échanges avec des interlocuteurs internationaux.

Benefits

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé.

Ce qui nous distingue :

Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse qui offre à ses collaborateurs l'opportunité d'évoluer sur des projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée. Notre modèle de services intégré, combinant conseil, Functional Service Provider et Full Service, permet à nos collaborateurs de développer leurs expertises aux côtés d'acteurs majeurs des Life Sciences.

En rejoignant cette mission, vous participerez directement à des projets de transferts de produits pharmaceutiques, avec un rôle central dans la maîtrise de la qualité, la qualification des équipements et la préparation des installations à leur exploitation.

Exceller avec bienveillance

Chez Excelya, la bienveillance est au cœur de nos actions. Nous favorisons l'égalité des chances et construisons un environnement de travail diversifié, équitable et inclusif, où chacun peut s'épanouir, être reconnu et contribuer pleinement à une mission commune.

Vos défis deviennent notre mission collective. Ensemble, nous transformons les idées ambitieuses en réalisations concrètes, à la manière d'Excelya.

Postulez dès aujourd'hui et devenez un Excelyate !

Infrastructure Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Manage and automate the fleet – build services for provisioning, health checks, upgrades, and incident remediation

  • Uphold reliability – embed observability, graceful degradation, and rollback paths into every layer you touch

  • Architect the network – design and evolve a high-throughput, low-latency fabric tailored to our high performance use-cases

  • Ship software, not scripts – develop clean, testable code (mostly Go) that treats our fleet like a first-class API

  • Drive efficiency – improve utilization and power-to-performance ratios so capacity grows slower than usage

  • Partner across the stack – work with product, infra, and platform teams to scope and deliver features like storage-aware scheduling, cache volumes, and other developer-facing features

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience engineering large-scale infrastructure - writing the software that runs fleets, not just operating existing hyperscalers

  • Depth in network architecture, data-center design, and performance tuning

  • Hands-on time deploying and managing compute hardware at scale (servers, switches, etc)

  • Fluency with modern orchestration and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible - plus the judgment to know when to build vs. buy)

  • A track record of delivering reliable systems and measurable efficiency gains

You can expect:

  • Competitive salary and stock options

  • Flexible working hours

  • Market-leading parental leave

Life at Namespace Labs:

  • We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

  • We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

  • We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

jobs.title: ☀️️German-Speaking Customer Support Specialist-Relocate to Sunny Greece🇬🇷
jobs.description:
Ready for a Work-Life Upgrade under the Mediterranean Sun?

Imagine swapping cold commutes and grey skies for morning frappés, after-work dips in the Aegean, and weekends exploring island hideaways or ancient historic streets. If you speak German and have been dreaming of an exciting international fresh start, this is your sign!

At Next Job Abroad, we don't believe in a one-size-fits-all approach. We treat your job search like a personalized matching service. We partner with leading international customer experience hubs in Greece working with some of the world’s most recognized brands (think top-tier tech, e-commerce, gaming, travel, and automotive giants). Together, we make sure you land in a role that fits your background, strengths, and long-term goals.

What You’ll Be Doing (The Role)

As a Customer Experience Specialist, you will be the voice and face of global brands for German-speaking customers across Europe:

  • Be the Problem Solver: Assist customers via phone, live chat, and/or email with inquiries regarding products, order tracking, bookings, or account support.
  • Deliver Top-Class Service: Turn tricky situations into positive customer moments through clear, empathetic, and friendly communication.
  • Troubleshoot & Guide: Walk users through basic technical issues, service setups, or account features step-by-step.
  • Collaborate Globally: Work side-by-side with international colleagues in an inspiring, multicultural environment.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay updated on the latest brand features, tools, and updates with ongoing support.

Requirements

  • Fluency in German: Native or fluent (C1/C2 level) in both written and spoken communication.
  • Good English Knowledge: (B2 level or higher) to navigate company systems and communicate with international team members.
  • Work Eligibility: EU Passport or a valid legal work permit for Greece.

jobs.title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus

Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche.

Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt.

Deine Rolle bei June

Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO.

Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche. 

Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen.


Anforderungen

Was du mitbringst

  • Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten.

  • Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich) 

  • Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools.

  • Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs).

  • AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst.

  • Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel. 

  • Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung.


Aufgabenbereich

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience.

  • Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst.

  • Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen.

  • Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich.

  • Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team.

Our Mission

Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.

Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.

What You'll Work On

  • Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds.

  • Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare.

  • World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels.

  • Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains.

  • Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships.

Who We're Looking For

A research scientist who has led work on world models, self-supervised learning or probabilistic spatio-temporal modelling, and who wants to see it run on real sites. You are rigorous about what a result does and does not show, and pragmatic about getting it into a product.

Your Background

  • PhD in machine learning, computer vision, robotics or a related field, with first-author publications at top venues.

  • Research experience in world models, video or latent prediction, self-supervised representation learning, or probabilistic modelling of spatio-temporal data.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Reliability & Test Infrastructure)
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will own the path a code change takes from commit to robot, and the evidence behind every gate on that path. Today the honest answer to "is this build safe?" is "it worked on the test robot." You will replace that with a system: the simulation environment the team tests against, the regression suites that run on every change, the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and the release gates that decide whether a build can go onto a robot that will patrol a customer site alone tonight.

This is the first engineer dedicated to reliability and test infrastructure, and it sits in our Robot Autonomy team, next to the engineers building perception, localisation, planning and locomotion. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built.

What You'll Work On

  • Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them.

  • Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab.

  • Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change.

  • Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you.

  • Failure injection: drop sensors, degrade LiDAR returns, kill the network link, corrupt odometry, then verify the system degrades and recovers the way we tell customers it does.

  • Field incidents to tests: when a robot misbehaves on site, reproduce it deterministically and turn it into a permanent regression test.

  • Reproducibility: log capture, replay tooling, deterministic seeds, versioned scenarios, and coverage metrics that are honest about what they do not cover.

  • Acceptance criteria: turn product and customer requirements into measurable tests, and report against them without softening the numbers.

Who We're Looking For

A test, validation or reliability engineer who has shipped a product where failure had consequences, and who has seen what changes when a fleet goes from one unit to fifty. You treat simulation and CI as production infrastructure that you own, not tools you consume. You have judgment about what is worth testing: we want a safety net, not a wall of green ticks that hides the real risk. And you are comfortable being the person who says a build is not going out.

Your Background

  • 4+ years in test, validation, reliability, SRE or platform engineering on a product that shipped to customers.

  • Experience with a complex system at scale: autonomous driving, drones, industrial automation, medical devices or similar.

  • Strong Python and/or C++, with solid CI/CD and containerised infrastructure skills.

  • Hands-on with a robotics simulator run as production infrastructure: Isaac Sim preferred, Gazebo, MuJoCo or equivalent accepted.

  • Comfortable owning cloud infrastructure and GPU orchestration, not just consuming it.

  • Enough hardware literacy to read a timing problem or a flaky sensor trace, and the judgment to know when to hand it to Hardware.

Nice to Have

  • ROS 2.

  • Hardware-in-the-loop rigs and bench automation.

  • Fleet telemetry and observability (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).

  • Functional safety or comparable standards work.

  • On-prem, air-gapped or defence deployment experience.

  • Having been on call for hardware in the field.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Location: Paris (75002), 2 days remote per week

  • Total Engineering Team at Escape: 21 Engineers, 4 Technical Leads, 4 Squads

About Escape

Escape is offensive security for the teams that are 100x outnumbered. We build AI agents that find and exploit vulnerabilities in modern applications, APIs, and microservices: the way a real attacker would, but at the speed of a CI pipeline.

We're a Y Combinator W23 company. We just closed an $18M Series A in March 2026 led by Balderton Capital (with Uncorrelated Ventures, IRIS, and YC following on). Our customers and partners include Zoom, Schibsted, Wiz, Pandadoc, and a growing list of teams who've stopped pretending annual pen tests are enough. We're 40 people split between Paris and NYC, scaling to 80 in the next 12 months.

The product surface is real: ASM, business-logic-aware DAST, and AI Pentesting GA-ing this year. The competitive thesis is that LLMs collapsed the cost of offensive engineering by 1000x, and the companies that ship that capability into production first will own the next decade of the category. We're betting we're those companies.

About the Role

In AI, context is the moat. At Escape, the data model is the context: and a team of three owns it end to end.

Every Escape product (ASM, DAST, AI Pentesting) is built on top of one data model rich enough to represent an entire attack surface and everything our agents learn about it. That model is our moat, and this team owns it. You'll own the schema at the heart of the company and the last mile that delivers our offensive R&D to customers through the GraphQL API and the product UI. If it ships to a customer, it goes through your team.

This is not a CRUD SaaS role in security clothing. It's the highest-leverage seat in product engineering: small team, central surface, and a direct line from your commits to what a CISO sees. "Senior" here means you set technical direction, not just execute it.

What You'll Do

  • Own the data model that is the moat: Design and evolve the schema representing tens of thousands of assets, millions of findings, multi-identity context, and everything our AI accumulates across engagements. This compounds: get it right and the whole platform gets stronger.

  • Turn R&D into Product for customers: Turn the output of our offensive AI research into something teams actually use: through the Svelte frontend, the GraphQL API, integrations, and real-time data refresh. You're the bridge between technology and value.

  • Push PostgreSQL to its edge: Query optimization, index design, pagination, caching, low-latency search over millions of records. The platform is intensely data-driven and the standard playbook runs out fast. This is most of the job.

  • Build AI-native workflows: Guided triage, assisted remediation, signal extraction from noisy scan data. AI is woven through the product, not bolted on: you build the surfaces where it meets the user.

  • Drive architecture: Data modeling, system design, GraphQL schema. You decide how we build, not just what: with a real, un-gimmicky path to Tech Lead.

Our Tech Stack & Focus

Frontend: Svelte + TypeScript, GraphQL client Backend: Node.js, GraphQL (Yoga + Pothos), Prisma, PostgreSQL, Kafka Infra: AWS, GitLab CI, Grafana Adjacent deep tech: Python (AI/ML), Go (network tooling)

  • ❤️‍🩹 Top-tier health insurance with Alan

  • 🍕 Meal vouchers with Swile

  • 💪 EGYM Wellpass sport subscription

  • 📚 Continuous learning: budgets for books and online courses

  • 💻 Premium equipment to support your work

  • 🎁 Dedicated time for open-source projects

  • 🌍 Present at top international conferences (RSAC, BlackHat, DEFCON, BSides, APIDays)

About You

  • 5+ years building production web apps, genuinely strong on both frontend and backend

  • Deep TypeScript knowledge: you use the type system to its full potential, you don't just tolerate it

  • Proven experience designing (not just consuming) GraphQL schemas A real passion for product, craft, and design: you care how it feels, not only whether it works

  • Strong ownership: you fix the problem the moment you spot it Excellent communicator: able to explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineering stakeholders

Nice to have:

  • Svelte expertise Security / DevSecOps background Early-stage startup experience

Ready to own the moat of an AI-native security company? Apply now to join Escape and ship offensive security to the teams that need it most.

jobs.description:
Passionate about Cybersecurity, open-source or network effect products? Interested in Sales?

Join CrowdSec to build a safer internet for everyone.

What we do

We aim to deter opportunistic and organized cybercrime through an Internet-scale, real-time security network. This network is powered by hundreds of thousands of servers sharing the aggression they block with our open-source software. By coupling this local behavior analysis and sharing its findings within our community, we create a real-time map of IP addresses used by cybercriminals, a large-scale reputation system, and a Crowd-Sourced Cyber Threat Intelligence of unprecedented magnitude that will counter the vast majority of technical hacks.

Who We Are

CrowdSec is a human-sized team of cybersecurity experts. Most of the team has worked remotely since day 1. The CrowdSec solution is used in 180+ countries, it is a well-known, unique, collaborative, open-source security solution that protects hundreds thousands of users.
